name: LLM Inference Library (oLLM Alternative)
description: Memory-aware paged KV cache with GPU/CPU/disk residency, prefetch, and eviction — 100k+ token contexts on Apple Silicon. Streaming softmax via log-sum-exp, plus a Metal kernel registry with MPS fallback for Llama, Qwen, and Mistral.

name: Lifelong Pathway AI Craft
description: AI-driven career platform that assesses skills, finds gaps, and generates learning paths. React/TypeScript dashboards with a Flask backend, Groq for generation, and optional Milvus retrieval.

name: Transformer — from scratch
description: Full transformer architecture implemented in PyTorch without high-level abstractions. Encoder, decoder, multi-head attention, positional encoding.

name: Multihead-Attention Mechanism
description: Custom attention mechanism for multi-topic queries. Routes sub-queries to specialized SLMs based on topic detection.

name: Nano-GPT
description: Implementation of Andrej Karpathy's nanoGPT. Character-level language model with self-attention.
